decisions.reason: The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits the public referral statistics to replacement-contract referrals and excludes old-contract records.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already records replacement-contract-only mint statistics and numbering restarting at #1.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits the displayed prize-pool state to the replacement contract's new draw cycle.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already excludes old-contract commission records from active displays and retains replacement-contract commissions.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already resets the countdown source to the replacement contract's new draw cycle and excludes old progress.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already restricts dashboard ownership to successfully minted replacement-contract NFTs and excludes old-contract NFTs.
The existing message-539 MODIFY already limits visible ticket state to replacement-contract NFTs and new draws while excluding old-contract tickets.
Starting fresh on a replacement contract does not change the required metadata fields; each replacement NFT can still expose its own mint number as its referral code.
The contract migration and exclusion of legacy NFTs do not change the image sizing or wallet-rendering requirements.
The migration decision changes which contract state is used but does not alter the commission amount, trigger, recipient, timing, limit, or payout mode.
The existing message-539 INTRODUCE already records the complete accepted migration policy, including fresh state, numbering from #1, legacy-contract exclusion, and no copy migration.
The existing FAQ remains valid under restarted numbering and does not promise continuity of old-contract NFTs or referral records.
